records.subject: FastStream
records.title: FastStream PR #2961: FastAPI 0.140 slotted Dependant compatibility
records.text: In merged FastStream PR #2961 (+55/-11 across 6 files, merged 2026-07-28 by Lancetnik), Joshua made FastStream's FastAPI dependency adapter compatible with FastAPI 0.140's slotted Dependant dataclass by recreating it as an extensible subclass built from FastAPI's dataclass fields, restoring model/custom_fields/flat_params metadata; he added regression tests for native fields, nested Depends and FastStream-specific fields and bumped the FastAPI pin and lockfile to 0.140.0.

records.subject: Apache Arrow Rust
records.title: Apache Arrow Rust PR #10486: ListView child nullability validation
records.text: In merged Apache Arrow Rust PR #10486 (+35/-10 across 2 files, merged 2026-07-30 by Jefffrey, closing issue #10476), Joshua fixed the JSON reader constructing ListView arrays without validating child nullability — which let JSON null be accepted for a non-nullable child — by replacing unchecked construction with GenericListViewArray::try_new (returning ArrowError on invalid nullability) and adding regression coverage for ListView and LargeListView.

records.subject: Calkit
records.title: Calkit PR #1028: scope single-item runs to skip unrelated subprojects
records.text: In merged Calkit PR #1028 (+160/-1 across 3 files, merged 2026-07-27 by petebachant, fixing #963), Joshua made --single-item runs skip environment and notebook preparation for unrelated subprojects while preserving prep when the target belongs to an inline/isolated subproject, and limited selected-subproject env checks to the requested stage, with regression coverage for an unrelated parent stage and a selected subproject stage.

records.subject: faststream_fastapi
records.title: faststream_fastapi PR #2: preserve FastStream schema metadata in FastAPI dependants
records.text: In merged faststream_fastapi PR #2 (+55/-3 across 2 files, merged 2026-07-30 by IvanKirpichnikov onto develop), Joshua fixed FastAPI's slotted Dependant rejecting the extra metadata FastStream expects — typed subscriber schema generation reached parse_handler_params() without a model and failed with AssertionError — by creating a small Dependant subclass that preserves every native dataclass field and restores model/custom_fields/flat_params, with a focused regression test. This is a companion fix to FastStream #2961 in a related community package.

records.subject: Mellea
records.title: Mellea PR #1469: stop HF generation workers on stream timeout
records.text: In merged Mellea PR #1469 (+174/-7 across 4 files, merged 2026-07-31 by ajbozarth, fixing #1242), Joshua fixed HF generation continuing in a background worker thread after Mellea's per-chunk stream guard timed out: he added an optional timeout callback to send_to_queue() wired to the HF cancellation hook in both standard and KV-cache streaming paths, running only when Mellea's own stream guard expires, leaving backend-raised TimeoutError unchanged and ensuring callback failures cannot replace the original timeout.

records.subject: Mellea
records.title: Mellea PR #1471: mocked backend tracing test coverage
records.text: In merged Mellea PR #1471 (+180/-0 in one file, merged 2026-07-30 by ajbozarth, fixing #1318), Joshua added mocked Ollama transport tests for five backend tracing behaviors — span duration across async generation, parent/child context propagation, token-usage attributes after completion, span lifetime before awaiting, and separate spans for consecutive generations — giving a fast local path that does not require Ollama while leaving existing real-Ollama e2e tests unchanged.

records.subject: OpenAI Agents Python
records.title: OpenAI Agents SDK PR #3991: retry pre-response WebSocket server errors
records.text: In merged OpenAI Agents Python PR #3991 (+74/-5 across 2 files, merged 2026-07-27 by seratch), Joshua fixed Responses WebSocket server_error frames bypassing provider-suggested retry policies when arriving before response processing begins: he classifies error_type="server_error" with code=None frames as retryable while preserving existing overload behavior and replay-safety boundaries, leaving coded non-transient errors unaffected. Tests: websocket_get_retry_advice (19 passed), full file 126 passed.

records.subject: Pydantic AI Harness
records.title: Pydantic AI Harness PR #503: report unexpected Code Mode session resets
records.text: In merged Pydantic AI Harness PR #503 (+44/-2 across 4 files, merged 2026-07-30 by adtyavrdhn, closing #481), Joshua made the harness report unexpected host-side execution failures to the model as retries after resetting the invalid Code Mode session — previously a silent state-loss path — while preserving existing sandbox-panic and interruption behavior, adding regression coverage and documenting the reset contract.

records.subject: Volyx Lens
records.title: Volyx Lens — private macOS multimodal context assistant
records.text: Volyx Lens is a privacy-oriented, context-aware macOS assistant (Electron v43) that combines user-selected screen context, microphone input, system/meeting audio, local OCR, relevance-ranked retrieval, transcription and multiple AI providers without routing through a VolyxAI server (bring-your-own provider). Joshua built focused context selection, provider-aware routing, consent controls, secure Electron boundaries, automated tests and release checks. Live: https://volyxlens.pages.dev. Its capture-exclusion behavior is best-effort, not guaranteed invisibility.

records.subject: Local Review Intelligence
records.title: Local Review Intelligence — local-first RAG over review data
records.text: Local Review Intelligence (repo local_AI_agent) is a local-first review-intelligence RAG app powered by Ollama and embedded ChromaDB. It lets a user explore a bundled restaurant dataset or map any review CSV, filter evidence and ask grounded questions with validated source citations. Joshua built adaptable field mapping, stable record identity, recoverable vector indexes, citation validation, bounded repair, privacy-safe diagnostics and an installable CLI.

records.subject: Local Review Intelligence
records.title: Citation validation and bounded repair
records.text: Local Review Intelligence validates model citations against retrieved source identities and permits at most one bounded repair attempt for eligible citation failures. Rejected raw model output is not shown as a successful answer; content-derived source IDs survive reordering, and analytics still load when Ollama is unavailable (safe offline state).

records.subject: Local Review Intelligence
records.title: Local Review Intelligence retrieval evaluation
records.text: Local Review Intelligence is Joshua's clearest RAG and evaluation project. Its clean 30-case benchmark (25 answerable + 5 abstention) measured Semantic Recall@5 of 0.913 against 0.770 for BM25, with answer success and citation validity of 0.880 (semantic hit_rate@5=1.0, MRR@5=0.96).

records.subject: Local Review Intelligence
records.title: Local Review Intelligence detailed eval metrics
records.text: The Local Review Intelligence evaluation (app v0.2.0, git 25b65ff) reported abstention recall of 1.0 (5/5 unanswerable correctly abstained), expected_action_accuracy 0.90 and reference_term_support_proxy 0.86. Config: chat model llama3.2:latest, embeddings mxbai-embed-large, dataset realistic_restaurant_reviews.csv (123 reviews), RAG mean latency ~27.4s, 21 repair attempts with 13 successes, on local Ollama v0.32.5, Linux, Python 3.11.15.

records.subject: Football Forecasting Lab
records.title: Football Forecasting Lab — temporal ML evaluation pipeline
records.text: Football Forecasting Lab (repo football_predictor) is a leakage-aware temporal ML pipeline that produces calibrated Home/Draw/Away probabilities by combining an XGBoost classifier with independent-Poisson score estimates, keeping frozen backtests, live forecasts and synthetic interface data separate, served via FastAPI with a Streamlit dashboard and data scrapers plus temporal feature engineering.

records.subject: Football Forecasting Lab
records.title: Football Forecasting Lab temporal evaluation
records.text: Football Forecasting Lab uses chronological training, calibration and frozen test windows to avoid temporal leakage. Its auditable rolling-origin evaluation over six Premier League seasons (2019–2025, three expanding-window folds) covered 1,140 test matches at 53.77% weighted accuracy versus a 45.09% majority baseline and a 56.70% normalized Bet365 benchmark: it beat naive accuracy/log-loss/Brier baselines in all three folds but beat the bookmaker in none, an honestly reported negative result (weighted log-loss 0.976 vs 0.949; Brier 0.580 vs 0.562).

records.subject: ChainScope
records.title: ChainScope — read-only Solana & Ethereum wallet analyzer
records.text: ChainScope (repo sol-eth-wallet-analyzer) is a read-only web app plus async Telegram bot that inspects public Solana and Ethereum addresses, reporting native balances with USD and detailed SPL-token portfolio analytics for Solana, with no wallet connection or signature. Prices come from Coinbase with CoinGecko fallback and Solana market data from DexScreener; it supports SPL Token and Token-2022 holdings, dust filtering and in-browser CSV/JSON export. Live demo: chainscope-wallet-analyzer.onrender.com.

records.subject: Telegram Social Video Downloader
records.title: Telegram Social Video Downloader — n8n + FastAPI workflow
records.text: Telegram Social Video Downloader is a self-hosted n8n + FastAPI + yt-dlp workflow that accepts TikTok/Instagram/X/Facebook links via a Telegram webhook in n8n, queues the download, normalizes media and returns it to chat, with host allowlisting, bounded workers, queue limits, restart recovery, idempotent update handling and non-root container execution.

records.subject: Noughtline
records.title: Noughtline — server-authoritative real-time Tic-Tac-Toe
records.text: Noughtline is a real-time, server-authoritative Tic-Tac-Toe built on React + Express + Socket.IO + SQLite with authenticated guest sessions, multiplayer series, persistent progression and a two-currency cosmetic economy. It enforces server-validated moves/turns/bounds, best-of-1/3/5, a 30s reconnection grace before one-time forfeit settlement, an immutable currency ledger, Paystack packages with signed-webhook idempotent crediting, JWT auth, rate limits and automated tests. Live: noughtline.onrender.com.

records.subject: PassGen
records.title: PassGen — secure password/passphrase generator
records.text: PassGen (repo password-generator) is a CLI plus web password/passphrase generator with a FastAPI backend and a static Web-Crypto demo. It uses Python secrets for CSPRNG randomness, computes entropy as log2 of the exact valid-output space after ambiguity filtering, uses the EFF wordlist for passphrases, does not persist web values and makes CLI history opt-in only. Tested on Python 3.14. Live demo: dk3yyyy.github.io/password-generator.

records.subject: ComboSorter
records.title: ComboSorter — streaming large-text toolkit
records.text: ComboSorter is a high-performance streaming Python toolkit for large structured text files, processing line-by-line (multi-GB without RAM exhaustion) with module chaining, GNU gsort integration, case-preserving email normalization and conservative sanitization.

records.subject: combo-splitter
records.title: combo-splitter — large-text splitting utility
records.text: combo-splitter is a high-performance Python utility that splits large text files into chunks by parts or lines per file, memory-efficient, with colored terminal output and an optional pyfiglet banner. Python 3.6+.

records.subject: user_count
records.title: user_count — durable Telegram user-counter bot
records.text: user_count is an async Telegram bot that registers unique users, reports counts to an admin and sends durable milestone notifications (persisting pending notifications for retry), with optional Redis rate-limiting and a 60s stats cache, SQLite locally or PostgreSQL via Docker Compose, running the container as an unprivileged user on a read-only filesystem, with automated tests and CI. It is explicitly not load-tested.

records.subject: VirusTotal Telegram Bot
records.title: VirusTotal Telegram Bot — malware scanning via Pyrogram
records.text: VirusTotal-Telegram-Bot is a Telegram bot built on Pyrogram (MTProto) plus the VirusTotal v3 API supporting 2GB file uploads (bypassing the 20MB bot limit; VT native up to 650MB), interactive inline detection/signature reports, URL and MD5/SHA1/SHA256 hash scanning, an upload_url flow for files over 32MB and local hashing.

records.subject: dnslookup
records.title: dnslookup — async DNS query CLI
records.text: dnslookup is a professional DNS query CLI with Rich terminal output, asynchronous concurrent resolution, a visual DNS trace tree from root servers, color-coded A/MX/NS/TXT tables and integrated WHOIS.
